name: The Game
overview: The Game is a slapstick comedy following two childhood friends, Waseem and Mazo, who along with their families are unwittingly pulled into a game of pranks and challenges orchestrated by a mysterious stranger. Starring fan favourites Hesham Maged, Chico, Moataz El Tony, and Bayoumi Fouad, the series delivers non-stop laughs as the rivalry escalates across five seasons of outrageous schemes, family chaos, and hilarious confrontations.

seasons.name: The Game
seasons.overview: Since childhood, Wasim and Mazo have always been competing against each other. As their competitiveness eases with age, they are forced back to their never-ending rivalry when a mysterious person provokes their old desire to one-up one another.

seasons.name: Monster Level
seasons.overview: Despite the success of Mazu and Wasim in finding and disposing of the character of Samir, the two received new communication devices, which means that the game is still ongoing.

seasons.name: Big Boss
seasons.overview: In a comic framework, Hisham Majid and Chico appear with their real characters, as they refuse to present a new part of the game series, and after agreeing to raise their wages, they discover that it is a trick and a game from the producers of the series.

seasons.name: Champions League
seasons.overview: After Wasim hit the jackpot, Mazu is determined – this season more than ever – to bounce back from his frustrating defeat.
